chronology_targets: 2014 (Aug 15): PM announces abolition of Planning Commission
2015 (Feb 8): First meeting of NITI Aayog Governing Council
2017: Project SATH launched; End of 12th Five-Year Plan
2018: First edition of SDG India Index released
2021: First National Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) baseline report
tnpsc_traps: NITI Aayog is NOT a constitutional body (not created by Constitution) and NOT a statutory body (no Parliament Act).
NITI Aayog has NO power to allocate funds to ministries or states; financial power rests with Ministry of Finance.
Vice-Chairperson is appointed by the Prime Minister (not the President), and holds the rank of a Union Cabinet Minister.
CEO is appointed by the Prime Minister for a fixed tenure, and holds the rank of Secretary to the Government of India.
Planning Commission followed a top-down approach; NITI Aayog follows a bottom-up approach based on cooperative and competitive federalism.
The 12th Five-Year Plan (2012-2017) was the last Five-Year Plan of India. NITI Aayog introduced 15-Year Vision, 7-Year Strategy, and 3-Year Action Agenda.
Health and Nutrition has the highest weight (30%) in the Aspirational Districts Programme ranking matrix.
